reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000854 (the melody read from 000854a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Robert Schumann's dates (1810–1856) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Schumann_Robert (Schumann, Robert, 1810-1856; credited on CCEH 854 SCHUMANN, arranged by Lowell Mason); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Schumann agrees; CCEH's page gives none. Lowell Mason's dates (1792–1872) are from our page for the tune BETHANY (content/hymns/tunes/bethany.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1850. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000854a.nwc).
